description: Searches YouTube for `query` and returns the results as JSON. For each video: `videoId`, `title`, `url`, `channel` (name/id/url), `publishedText`, `viewCount` (+ text), `lengthSeconds` (+ text), `thumbnails`, `descriptionSnippet`, `badges`, `verified` and `isLive`. Filter with `type` (video / channel / playlist / all) and `sort` (relevance / date / views / rating), and collect up to `max_results` across pages. Returns JSON. Billed like an API request; listing plugins bill one unit per result page they fetch, so keep max_results modest.

max_results.description: How many results to collect across pages (~20 per page). Default: 20.

proxy_country.description: Proxy country the request is sent from (ISO-2, e.g. 'US', 'DE'). Defaults to US.

sort.description: Ordering: relevance, rating, date, views. Default: relevance.

type.description: Result type: video, channel, playlist, movie, all. Default: video.

name: youtube_search
title: Search YouTube
